adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces TopicEmbed records that reference topics/posts but provides no foreign keys and no cleanup mechanism (TopicEmbed only has `belongs_to :topic, :post`; the migration adds only a unique index on `embed_url`). `TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed` blindly returns the stored `topic_id` via `pluck` without verifying the topic still exists. In `EmbedController#best`, if a TopicEmbed row remains after the topic is deleted, it will take the `topic_id` branch and call `TopicView.new(topic_id, ...)`, which will fail if that topic no longer exists (or is inaccessible), preventing the fallback retrieval path and making embeds for that URL persistently broken until the row is removed manually.
